what: Zappik, a young storm marten: a real slim weasel-like animal on four legs, painted as a real wild animal, half-grown but never a baby, with a long low lithe body, short legs, a small narrow pointed head with small rounded ears set low, sharp dark amber eyes and a long bushy tail. Its fur is rich warm golden-yellow with an amber tint, the gold of a buttercup faded in the sun, never greenish, with one broad dark slate-grey stripe running from between its ears down its spine to the tip of its tail, and a pale cream throat. A few small crackling sparks of bright yellow lightning jump at the tuft of fur on the very tip of its tail, touching the fur.
colours: rich warm golden-yellow fur with an amber tint, a broad dark slate-grey stripe down the spine and tail, a pale cream throat, dark amber eyes, a black nose, dark grey claws, small sparks of bright yellow lightning at the tail tip.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: it bounds forward low to the ground, back arched, all four short legs reaching, head up and alert, its bushy tail held high behind it with the little sparks crackling at the tip.
must_show: a slim golden-yellow weasel-like animal on four legs, seen from the side
a dark slate-grey stripe down its spine and tail
small yellow sparks at the tail tip only
a real young wild animal, painted seriously, not a mascot
must_not_show: crest of fur on the back

what: Voltpaw, the same storm marten half-grown into a hunter: a real lithe weasel-like predator on four legs, painted as a real wild animal, longer, leaner and stronger than the young one, with longer legs, a small narrow pointed head, golden-yellow all over the face like the body, with small rounded ears, sharp dark amber eyes, and a long bushy tail with two dark slate-grey bands round it. Its fur is rich warm golden-yellow with an amber tint, the gold of a buttercup faded in the sun, never greenish, with the same broad dark slate-grey stripe down its spine, now with a short stiff crest of slate-grey fur standing up along its shoulders, and a pale cream throat. Its front paws are dark slate-grey. Small jagged sparks of bright yellow zigzag lightning crackle among the stiff fur of its shoulder crest and at the tip of its tail, touching the fur. Its mouth is shut and empty.
colours: rich warm golden-yellow fur with an amber tint, a broad dark slate-grey stripe and short crest down the spine, two slate-grey bands round the tail, dark slate-grey front paws, a pale cream throat, dark amber eyes, a black nose, small bright yellow zigzag sparks at the shoulder crest and the tail tip.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: it trots forward with all four feet on the ground and its body horizontal, head raised and alert, ears up, mouth shut, looking ahead, the yellow sparks crackling in its shoulder crest and at its tail tip, its banded tail streaming out behind.
must_show: the same golden-yellow weasel-like animal with the slate-grey spine stripe, older and leaner
a short stiff crest of grey fur at the shoulders
small bright yellow sparks in the shoulder crest and at the tail tip
grey bands on the tail
mouth shut, nothing in the mouth

what: Thundertail, the same storm marten full-grown into a great storm beast: a long, powerful, deep-chested weasel-like animal on four legs, painted as a real wild animal, with the same small narrow pointed weasel's head as the young one, small rounded ears, sharp dark amber eyes, a thick mane of stiff golden-yellow fur round its neck and shoulders, and an enormous plume of a tail as long as its whole body, held high and curving over its back. Its fur is rich warm golden-yellow with an amber tint, the gold of a buttercup faded in the sun, never greenish, on its head, face, body and legs; only a dark slate-grey saddle stripe runs along its back with a tall stiff crest of fur, and its paws are dark slate-grey. Its throat is pale cream. The great tail is golden-yellow banded with dark slate-grey, and three thick jagged bolts of bright yellow zigzag lightning, each as long as its leg, leap out from the tail along its length, joined to the fur.
colours: rich warm golden-yellow fur with an amber tint on the head, body, legs and mane, a dark slate-grey saddle stripe and crest along the back, dark slate-grey paws, a pale cream throat, a golden-yellow tail banded with slate-grey, dark amber eyes, a black nose, bright yellow zigzag lightning along the tail.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: all four of its feet are planted on the ground and its body is long and horizontal; it stands proud and tall, head held high on its neck looking ahead, mouth shut, ears up, mane bristling, its huge lightning-crackling tail arched high over its back.
must_show: the same golden-yellow weasel-like beast with a narrow pointed weasel head, now full-grown, powerful and grand
a thick bristling golden mane at the neck and a dark grey saddle stripe with a tall crest
an enormous banded tail held high with yellow lightning along it
golden body and legs, not grey
plainly the grandest of the three stages

what: Seedling, a young thorn lizard: a real heavy-set lizard on four legs, painted as a real reptile, half-grown but never a baby, squat and low, with a short blunt head, sharp gold-amber eyes, stout bowed legs with dark claws and a short thick tail. Its scales are deep emerald-green on its back, legs and tail and pale leaf-green on its throat and belly, smooth and even, with no spots. From a small knot of dark brown bark on its back between its shoulders grows one small young sapling shoot, a short green stem no taller than its head with two broad bright green leaves, rooted in the bark, well behind its head.
colours: deep emerald-green scales, a pale leaf-green throat and belly, a small knot of dark brown bark, a green shoot with two bright green leaves, gold-amber eyes, dark brown claws.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: all four feet planted on the ground and its body horizontal and low, it strides forward with one front foot ahead of the other, head raised and alert, mouth closed, the little shoot on its back leaning back with the movement. The whole lizard, its tail tip and the top of the shoot are well inside the picture.
must_show: a squat deep-green lizard on four legs, seen from the side
a small knot of bark on its back with one sapling shoot of two leaves
a real young reptile painted seriously, not a mascot
must_not_show: open mouth showing a pink tongue

what: Thornback, the same thorn lizard half-grown: a real heavy-set lizard on four legs, painted as a real reptile, longer, heavier and stronger than the young one, with a broad blunt head, sharp gold-amber eyes, stout bowed legs with dark claws and a long thick tail. Its scales are deep emerald-green on its back, legs and tail and pale leaf-green on its throat and belly, smooth and even, with no spots. The bark on its back has spread into one ridge of dark brown woody bark plates running from its neck down its spine to the base of its tail, each plate set with one long hooked dark brown thorn, and green vines with broad bright green leaves twist between the thorns, with three or four small closed white flower buds among them.
colours: deep emerald-green scales, a pale leaf-green throat and belly, dark brown bark plates and dark brown thorns, green vines with bright green leaves, small closed white buds, gold-amber eyes, dark brown claws.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: all four feet planted on the ground and its body horizontal, it crouches braced with its front legs wide and its head lowered and thrust forward at the left, jaws open in a hiss showing small white teeth, its thorny back arched and its tail lashing behind.
must_show: the same deep-green lizard, bigger and heavier
a ridge of dark bark plates with hooked thorns all down its spine
green vines and leaves twisting between the thorns
small closed white buds, no open flowers

what: Bloomsaur, the same thorn lizard full-grown into a great beast: a massive heavy lizard on four thick bowed legs, painted as a real reptile, with a broad heavy head crowned by two short curved horns of dark brown wood, sharp gold-amber eyes, dark claws and a long thick tail. Its scales are deep emerald-green on its back, legs and tail and pale leaf-green on its throat and belly, smooth and even, with no spots. Its whole back is a mantle of dark brown woody bark plates set with long hooked dark brown thorns, overgrown with thick green vines and broad bright green leaves, and crowned with five or six big open white flowers with five broad petals and gold centres, each flower as big as its head, scattered along its back from shoulders to hips.
colours: deep emerald-green scales, a pale leaf-green throat and belly, dark brown bark plates, thorns and wooden horns, green vines with bright green leaves, big open pure white flowers with gold centres, gold-amber eyes, dark brown claws.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: it walks on all four legs like a huge lizard; all four of its feet are planted on the ground and its body is horizontal; it braces with its front legs wide and its horned head lowered and thrust forward at the left, jaws open in a roar, its flowering, thorny back high and its tail sweeping behind.
must_show: the same deep-green lizard, now massive and grand, on four legs
a thorny bark mantle over its back overgrown with vines
several big open white flowers with gold centres on its back
two short dark wooden horns on its head
plainly the grandest of the three stages

what: Emberpup, a young ember wyrm: a lean dragon whelp on four legs, painted as a real reptile, half-grown but never a baby, with no wings at all, a slim neck, a narrow wedge-shaped head with two small backswept black horns, sharp bright gold eyes and a long thin tail. Its scales are bright scarlet-red, the red of red sealing wax, glossy and lit, on its back, head, legs and tail, and its belly and throat are charcoal-black plates with thin lines of glowing orange showing between them. Along its spine runs one row of small black spines, and between them a row of small glowing coals of bright orange, like embers in a hearth, set in the scales. One small thin wisp of grey smoke curls up from its nostrils, joined to the nose.
colours: bright scarlet-red scales, the red of red sealing wax, charcoal-black belly and throat plates with thin glowing orange lines between them, small black horns and black spines, a row of small glowing bright orange embers along the spine, black claws, bright gold eyes, a small wisp of grey smoke.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: it walks on all four legs like a lizard; all four feet are planted on the ground and its body is horizontal and low; it prowls forward with its neck stretched out and head raised and alert, mouth closed, the wisp of smoke rising from its nose, its thin tail curling up behind.
must_show: a lean bright scarlet dragon whelp on four legs, seen from the side, plainly readable on a dark floor
no wings
small black horns and a row of small black spines with glowing orange embers between them
a black belly with glowing orange lines
a real young reptile painted seriously, not a mascot
must_not_show: flame on the tip of the tail

what: Flamescale, the same ember wyrm half-grown: a young dragon that walks on all four legs like a huge lizard, painted as a real reptile, longer and stronger than the whelp, with a long neck, a wedge-shaped head with two backswept black horns as long as its head, sharp bright gold eyes, a taller row of black spines down its back and a long tail. Its scales are bright scarlet-red, the red of red sealing wax, on its back, head, legs and tail, and its belly and throat are charcoal-black plates with lines of glowing orange showing between them. Between the black spines along its spine runs the same row of glowing coals of bright orange, now bigger. It now has two wings, their bones black and their membranes glowing deep orange with dark red veins, as if lit from within by fire.
colours: bright scarlet-red scales, the red of red sealing wax, charcoal-black belly and throat plates with glowing orange lines between them, black horns, spines and claws, a row of glowing bright orange embers along the spine, bright gold eyes, wings with black bones and glowing deep orange membranes with dark red veins.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: it walks on all four legs like a crocodile; all four of its feet are planted on the ground, its body is long, low and horizontal and its belly close to the ground; its long neck stretches forward level with its back and its head is held low and forward at the left, mouth shut, looking ahead; its two wings are raised above its back, bent sharply at the wrist like two tall arches with the tips pointing down; its tail sweeps out level behind.
must_show: the same scarlet dragon with black belly, black horns and the ember row along the spine, older and longer
two raised wings with glowing orange membranes
longer black horns and taller spines than the whelp
walking low on all four legs, body level
no fire breath yet
must_not_show: standing up on its hind legs
flame on the tip of the tail

what: Infernodrake, the same ember wyrm full-grown into a great dragon: a massive, heavy, thick-bodied dragon that walks on all four legs like a huge lizard, painted as a real reptile, with a long thick neck, a broad heavy wedge-shaped head with a crown of long sweeping black horns, sharp bright gold eyes, thick legs with black claws and a long heavy tail. Its scales are bright scarlet-red, the red of red sealing wax, on its back, head, legs and tail, each scale edged with fine glowing orange cracks, and its belly and throat are charcoal-black plates with broad lines of glowing orange between them. The row of embers along its spine has become real fire: a row of bright orange-yellow tongues of flame rising between tall black spines along the back of its neck and down its whole spine, plainly fire and not fur or hair, joined to the body. Its two great wings, with black bones and membranes glowing deep orange, are half raised above its back, bent sharply at the wrist like two tall arches with the tips pointing down. Its mouth is shut; a thin line of orange glow shows between its lips and a thin wisp of grey smoke rises from its nostrils.
colours: bright scarlet-red scales, the red of red sealing wax, with fine glowing orange cracks, charcoal-black belly and throat plates with glowing orange lines, long black horns, spines and claws, bright gold eyes, a row of bright orange-yellow flames along the neck and spine, half-raised wings with glowing deep orange membranes, a thin wisp of grey smoke.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: all four of its feet are planted on the ground, its body is horizontal and low and its belly close to the ground; it strides forward calm and stately, its heavy horned head held level with its shoulders on its long neck, looking ahead, mouth shut, the fire along its spine streaming back, its wings half raised.
must_show: the same scarlet dragon with black belly, black horns and fire along the spine, now massive, heavy and grand
a crown of long sweeping black horns
bright flames (not fur) burning along its neck and spine
calm and stately, mouth shut, not attacking
plainly the grandest of the three stages, told from Flamescale at a glance
must_not_show: flame on the tip of the tail
long stream of fire across the picture

what: Shellkit, a young tide turtle: a real young sea turtle, a few months out of the egg, painted as a real animal, small, neat and flat, with four paddle-shaped flippers and no feet, the front pair long for its body as a young turtle's are, a small beaked head on a short neck and dark eyes. Its skin is deep sea-blue speckled with small pale white spots. Its shell is low, smooth and plain, shaped like a flat river pebble, all one even dark slate-blue, with no rims, no ridge, no points and no barnacles.
colours: deep sea-blue skin with small pale white speckles, a smooth plain shell of even dark slate-blue, a dark grey beak, dark eyes.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal with flippers and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: it swims forward as if through water, its body horizontal and level, both long front flippers raised high and swept back like a bird's wings in a downstroke, its back flippers trailing, its head stretched forward and alert, mouth closed.
must_show: a real young blue sea turtle seen from the side, swimming, front flippers raised
pale white speckles on blue skin
a smooth plain flat dark slate-blue shell with no rims, ridge or points
small and young, plainly the least of the three stages
a real young animal painted seriously, not a mascot
must_not_show: white rims on the shell plates

what: Tideshell, the same tide turtle half-grown: a real sea turtle, painted as a real animal, much bigger and heavier than the young one, with four large paddle-shaped flippers and no feet, each flipper with a pale scalloped edge, a strong hooked beak and sharp dark eyes. Its skin is deep sea-blue speckled with pale white spots. Its shell has grown high-domed and ridged, as tall as its body is deep: dark slate-blue plates each boldly rimmed with pale foam-white, with a row of five big blunt pale white knobs standing along the middle ridge of the shell from front to back, each knob as big as its eye, and pale grey barnacles crusted on the shell's rim.
colours: deep sea-blue skin with pale white speckles, a shell of dark slate-blue plates boldly rimmed in pale foam-white with a row of big pale white knobs along the ridge, pale grey barnacles, a dark grey hooked beak, dark eyes.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal with flippers and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: its body horizontal and low on the ground, it heaves itself forward with its big front flippers planted wide, its head thrust forward on its neck, its hooked beak closed.
must_show: the same blue sea turtle, older and much bigger, crawling
a high-domed shell with bold white-rimmed plates and a row of big blunt white knobs along the ridge
barnacles on the shell rim
flippers with pale scalloped edges and a hooked beak

what: Torrentoise, the same tide turtle full-grown into a great ancient sea beast: a massive, heavy, real sea turtle, painted as a real animal, with four huge paddle-shaped flippers with pale scalloped edges and no feet, a great hooked beak, a heavy armoured head and sharp dark eyes. Its skin is deep sea-blue speckled with pale white spots, and its huge high-domed shell is made of dark slate-blue plates each rimmed with pale foam-white, crowned along its ridge with a row of tall pale white spikes, its rim fringed all round with short pale white points and crusted with pale grey barnacles. Its head is smooth, sea-blue and speckled like its flippers, with nothing on it; its great hooked beak is closed and stern. All the spikes are on the shell, standing up from its ridge like a crown, each spike as long as its head.
colours: deep sea-blue skin with pale white speckles, a shell of dark slate-blue plates rimmed in pale foam-white, tall pale white spikes and points, pale grey barnacles, a dark grey hooked beak, dark eyes.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal with flippers and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: its body horizontal and low, it heaves itself forward on its four great flippers, the front pair swept wide and planted, its armoured head thrust forward on its thick neck, beak closed, ancient and immovable.
must_show: the same blue sea turtle with white-rimmed slate-blue plates, now massive and ancient
a high shell crowned along its ridge with tall pale white spikes, much taller than Tideshell's points
a smooth head with a closed beak
plainly the grandest of the three stages
must_not_show: long stream of water across the picture

what: Waddlekind, a celestial duckling: a real mallard duckling, a few weeks old, painted as a real bird, with a small rounded body covered in soft fluffy down, a short flat dark grey bill, small dark eyes and two small stubby wings. Its down is bright golden-yellow on its face, throat and belly, with a dark olive-brown cap on the top of its head, a thin dark brown stripe through each eye, and dark olive-brown patches on its back and wings. A thin ring of pale gold light rests just on top of its head, touching it, as wide as its head: a small halo.
colours: bright golden-yellow down, a dark olive-brown cap, eye stripe and back patches, a dark grey bill, orange-brown webbed feet, dark eyes, a thin ring of pale gold light.
wears: It is a bird and wears nothing but the small ring of light.
holds: It is a bird and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, standing on its two webbed feet: it waddles forward mid-step with one foot lifted, its stubby wings held out from its sides, its head up and bill slightly open, peeping boldly.
must_show: a real mallard duckling, yellow down with a dark olive-brown cap and back
a thin gold halo resting on its head
a real bird painted seriously, not a toy

what: The Drake of the Covenant, the same celestial duck grown into a full-grown mallard drake: a real male mallard, painted as a real bird, proud and sleek, with a glossy deep emerald-green head, a narrow white ring round its neck, a rich chestnut-brown breast, a pale silver-grey body, a dark tail with one small black curl, a yellow bill and orange webbed feet. Its eyes are bright gold. The same thin ring of pale gold light, as wide as its head, now floats a little above its head: a halo. Just below the white ring it wears a broad collar of polished bright gold, as broad as its eye is wide, plainly gold against the chestnut breast, catching the light.
colours: a glossy deep emerald-green head, a white neck ring, a broad polished bright gold collar, a chestnut-brown breast, a pale silver-grey body, a yellow bill, orange feet, bright gold eyes, a thin ring of pale gold light.
wears: It wears only one broad collar of polished gold round its neck, and the halo above its head.
holds: It is a bird and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, standing on its two webbed feet: it rears up with its chest out and both wings half raised from its sides, its emerald head stretched forward and bill open in a challenge, one foot stepping forward.
must_show: a real mallard drake: emerald-green head, white neck ring, chestnut breast, grey body
a thin gold halo above its head
a broad bright gold collar round its neck, plain in the small sprite
gold eyes

what: Seraphimallard, the same celestial mallard drake grown into a holy seraph: a real male mallard, painted as a real bird, grand and noble, with a glossy deep emerald-green head, a narrow white ring and a broad collar of polished gold round its neck, a rich chestnut-brown breast, a pale silver-grey body and a yellow bill. Its eyes are bright gold, the gold of its halo. A ring of pale gold light floats above its head. Out of its back grow six wings of solid pale golden light, three on each side, one below the other, like the spokes of a wheel: on each side the top wing points up, the middle wing points straight out sideways, and the bottom wing points down and out. Each wing is a long blade of feathers of light with a bright white-gold edge, and the six wings make a ring of light round the duck.
colours: a glossy deep emerald-green head, a white neck ring and a broad gold collar, a chestnut-brown breast, a pale silver-grey body, a yellow bill, bright gold eyes, a ring of pale gold light, six wings of solid pale golden light with bright white-gold edges.
wears: It wears only its gold neck band and the halo above its head.
holds: It is a bird and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the front, a little turned to the left: it stands tall and upright on its two orange webbed feet, its chest out and its emerald head raised high, bill open in a call, its six wings of light spread round it like the spokes of a wheel, three on each side.
must_show: the same mallard drake: emerald-green head, white neck ring, chestnut breast, grey body
six wings of pale golden light, three on each side: up, sideways and down
bright gold eyes and the gold halo
plainly the grandest of the three stages

what: Fenrir, the colossal legendary wolf of the north who has come to fight at the hero's side: a monstrous, noble wolf on four legs, painted as a real animal but immense, enormously heavy, deep-chested and long-legged, with a huge broad head and long heavy jaws, a great thick shaggy ruff of long fur round its neck and shoulders, a crest of long stiff fur standing along its whole spine, a heavy bushy tail and huge paws as broad as shields with long dark claws. His coat is the mid steel-grey of a grey timber wolf in winter, dark charcoal-grey along the crest of his back and the top of his tail, mid steel-grey on his flanks and legs, and pale silver-grey only on his ruff, chest and muzzle: plainly a grey wolf, never white, never pale blue, never tan and never brown. His eyes burn pale icy blue with no pupils. Round his neck lies the broken ribbon Gleipnir: one broad flat smooth band of shining pale gold lying close round his neck under the ruff like a torque, snapped through at the front, its two short torn ends hanging down on his chest.
colours: mid steel-grey fur, dark charcoal-grey along the crest of the back and the top of the tail, pale silver-grey ruff, chest and muzzle, pale icy blue eyes, dark claws, a black nose and lips, a broad snapped band of shining pale gold round the neck.
wears: He wears only the torn gold ribbon round his neck.
holds: He is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: all four of his great paws are planted on the ground and his body is horizontal; he stands guard calm and proud, his huge head raised high on his thick neck, looking ahead with ears up, mouth shut, his ruff full, his great tail hanging low behind.
must_show: a colossal silver-grey wolf on four legs, seen from the side, standing proud and calm, mouth shut
a huge ruff, a spine crest and paws as broad as shields: plainly far beyond an ordinary wolf
pale icy blue eyes
a broad shining gold band round the neck, snapped at the front, readable in the small sprite
noble and protective, a guardian at the hero's side, not a fiend

what: The Ethereal Unicorn, a holy healer: a slender, graceful unicorn on four legs, painted as a real animal, built like a fine light horse with long slim legs, a delicate head, small neat ears and gentle dark eyes. Her coat is pale ivory-white all over with soft pale silver-grey shading and a faint pearly sheen. Her mane and tail are very long and flowing, pale gold, the gold of ripe wheat, the tail sweeping down almost to her hooves. Her cloven hooves are bright silver. From the middle of her brow grows one long straight spiral horn of bright gold, as long as her head and as thick at the base as her ear, a bold spiral, and at its very tip shines a small glint of white light like a plus sign: one spike up, one down, one left, one right, touching the tip.
colours: pale ivory-white coat with soft pale silver-grey shading and a faint pearly sheen, a long flowing pale gold mane and tail, bright silver hooves, one long thick spiral horn of bright gold, gentle dark eyes, a small white glint at the horn's tip.
wears: She is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: She is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: she prances forward with one foreleg raised high and bent at the knee, the other three hooves on the ground, her neck arched and her head held high, the golden horn pointing up and forward, her long pale gold mane and tail streaming back.
must_show: a slender pale ivory-white unicorn on four legs, seen from the side
one long thick bold spiral horn of bright gold on her brow, plain in the small sprite
a long flowing pale gold mane and tail
holy, gentle and pale, painted seriously, not a toy pony

what: a perfectly ordinary dairy cow standing in the dungeon as if nothing were strange about it: a real cow on four legs, painted as a real farm animal, placid and solid, with a broad bony head, two small short pale horns, ears sticking out sideways, a broad grey-pink muzzle, and a thin tufted tail. Her hide is short, in big bold patches of black and white over her head, body and legs. A dented brass cowbell hangs on a worn brown leather strap round her neck. Her large dark eyes stare straight at the viewer with a calm, slightly too knowing look, and deep in each eye there is the faintest tiny glint of red.
colours: short hide in big black and white patches, a grey-pink muzzle, two small pale ivory horns, black hooves, a dented brass cowbell on a worn brown leather strap, large dark eyes with a faint tiny red glint.
wears: She wears only the brass cowbell on its leather strap.
holds: She is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: she lies at rest on the floor on her belly with all four legs folded under her body, as a cow lies down in a field to chew the cud, her body low and level and her chest and belly resting on the bottom edge of the picture; she turns her head to look straight at the viewer, chewing her cud with a wisp of hay hanging from her mouth, perfectly calm.
must_show: an ordinary black and white dairy cow lying down at rest, legs folded under her
a brass cowbell on a leather strap
head turned to stare at the viewer, chewing
a real farm animal painted seriously, not a cartoon cow

what: an abyssal shimmer, a place where ancient power wells up through the dungeon floor: one slanted spinning oval of pale silver-white light hanging in the air, bright pure white at its heart and pale grey at its edges, with a soft depth of folded, swirling light inside it, and two broad curved tails of pale silver-white light spinning off it, one from its top sweeping round to the right and one from its bottom sweeping round to the left, both joined to the oval, so the whole is one compact whirl of light. It is light only, with nothing inside it and nobody near it, compact and wholly inside the picture, with clear backdrop on every side.
colours: pale silver-white and pale grey light, a pure white heart, faint pale grey shading in the folds.
pose: It spins and flickers in the air, leaning to one side, its streamers whirling round it.
must_show: a compact whirl of near-white light with a bright white heart
two curved tails of pale light joined to it
near-white or grey only, so the game's tint can colour it
nothing inside the light
must_not_show: rays to the edge of the picture
